(473)gri 'dul bca' gsham ni/sa chog legs par byas pa'i stegs bu gru bzhi mda' gang ba'i steng du/dpal dgu'i dkyil 'khor dpe ris ltar bris la/skyer

tei:div.tei:p: gri 'dul bca' gsham ni/ sa chog legs par byas pa'i stegs bu gru bzhi mda' gang ba'i steng du/ dpal dgu'i dkyil 'khor dpe ris ltar bris la/ skyer hom chag gang pa gru gsum chu zheng gab par brtsegs/ phyi rol du gtsang phur bcus bskor/ hom de dag re re'i rtsar lha bshos nag po re re/ brub khung dgur gri gshed kyi ling ga ra sog la/ mda' gri stong dmar mā ra ya phaṭaḥ sogs bris pa dgu'am gcig mchod rdzas gtor ma nag po bcu gcig rak+ta chang phud rnams dang*/ sreg rdzas/ shug pa tsher ma can dang*/ ba lu chag gang pa'i yam shing*/ nas/ bra bo/ sran ma/ so ba/ gro rnams dang*/ sman zangs su/ bya khrag rtsod khrag bya bran sna tshogs pa'i khrag ga bur gla rtsi sogs rtsi sman sna tshogs/ dug zangs su/ yungs dkar/ skye tsher/ sdong ros/ thang phrom/ re lcag lcags phye/ zangs phye/ dug sna/ ra khrag sogs khrag sna gang 'dzoms/ hom de'i lho nub tu/ rigs drug dang klu'i dal/ lan chags glud gtor re re/ mgor gri skyabs mchod rten dang*/ rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs/ hom gyi hor 'jag ma'i mi gzugs khyi snying khar nṛḥdang tshe 'das kyi ming rus bris pa la dri gos bkon/ hom gyi nub tu/ rma gso'i rdzas su/ rgya skyegs/ rtsod khrag ga bur/ gla rtsi/ gurgum/ thang dkar rgod kyi khrag bya bran mang po'i khrag (474) a ru ra/ rtsa dar ya kan nam dbyug gu shing rnams/ ka ra/ bu ram/ sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba bsham/ gzhan yang gri 'dul ba'i rdzas me chu sogs kyang 'du bya/ las gzhung bsrang zhing bum pa bsgrub/ tshogs las yan zin nas gri 'dul la 'jug gri 'dul zin nas bzlog gzhung bsrang ba dang*/ sngar rtsa dkyil du bzlog gtor gshom pa gzhung gi dgongs pa ma lags te/ brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes yin pas ma grub kyang 'gal ba med/ mnan pa sogs mi dgos pa gzhung gi dgongs pa'o// sreg rdzas la/ mar khu/ yam shing*/ til dkar nag dkar gsum/ mngar gsum/
so ba/ 'bras/ gro/ nas/ sran ma/ yungs dkar/ ku sha/ dūrba/ me tog dar sna/ sman sna/ rin po che'i rigs rnams so// dge'o//
